## Skipped tests (and why)

- `::tests.test_hybrid_optional` - needs the optional `sentence-transformers` package (experimental hybrid retriever); not run in the default environment.

## What the tests do NOT cover (known limitations)

- Retrieval quality on real, long, messy legal documents (the sample corpus is 7 short fictional documents).
- The real LLM: tests use a fake model to check the *validation* around it; `AnthropicLLM` was never run against the live API in the build environment.
- The hybrid (embedding) retriever and `scripts/pdf_to_text.py` (optional, untested here).
- Concurrency/load, authentication, and rate limiting (not implemented).
- Legal correctness: nothing here verifies real law; the sample documents are fictional.
